## Problems and decisions

- **Shell network.** The shell can reach GitHub and npm only. Downloads from Kenney, Poly Haven and the like go through the user's browser into `C:\Users\decca\Documents\StreetFightUK-assets` and are staged here.
- **Unextractable archive.** `MeleeWeaponsPack.rar` (199 MB) can't be extracted here (no unrar). The licence of `Melee Weapons - FREE.zip` is unrecorded, so it isn't used until it's confirmed.
- **Old props break the style guide.** The photo-scanned props already in `public/models/props` exceed the budgets. They're replaced as their rows come up.
